summary.oneLiner: PNGS Gargi accelerated store additions to 32 in FY26 (18 in Q4) driving 48% revenue growth, while strategically reducing reliance on parent-company SIS channels from ~78% to a targeted 65% by FY28. The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet with INR 78cr cash, funding aggressive EBO expansion without equity dilution while sustaining ~20% PAT margins despite new store ramp-up periods.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: SIS (P.N. Gadgil): ~78% of revenue FY26, targeting reduction to 65% by FY28. EBO/Other: ~22% of revenue FY26, becoming primary growth engine. Product Mix: 14KT Diamond ~35% of revenue; Sterling Silver balance.

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: N/A - Retail business model; Focus on same-store sales growth (SSSG ~30-32% in mature SIS) and new store contribution.

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.body: Revenue CAGR ~35% over next few years; Store additions: min 20 in FY27 (potential for more); Margins: EBITDA/PAT expected to remain stable (~20% PAT) with potential 100-150bps upside if new stores mature faster.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Untapped Maharashtra Tier 2/3 cities (Pune alone supports 8-10 more stores); Pan-India expansion into North (priority) and South (Hyderabad/Chennai/Bangalore initiated); Kiosk format in malls for lower capex entry.

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: Raw material volatility (Silver/Gold) managed via MRP pricing adjustments (cushion of INR 30-40k/kg for silver); Marketing spend low at 4-5% of sales; Local manufacturing (karigars) offsetting rising HR/rent costs.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Debt-free expansion prioritized; No equity dilution planned for organic growth; Cash reserves (INR 78cr) deployed for new EBOs; Open to inorganic acquisitions if strategically fit.

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident yet conservative; Emphasis on 'not less than' guidance to under-promise/over-deliver; Pragmatic on geography (profit over rigid state targets); Cautious on ATL marketing spend.

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: New store maturation delay (15-18 months outside Maharashtra vs 6-9 months in Maharashtra); Concentration risk with P.N. Gadgil SIS though reducing; Real estate availability in premium mall locations.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: Inventory strategy shift: Ban on imported ready silver jewelry forced vertical integration with local karigars using Italian/Turkish machinery, improving making cost margins; SSG in parent SIS channels running at 30-32% despite large base.
